lessons.title: Happy New Year!
lessons.en:
Ben: Happy New Year, Anna!
Anna: Happy New Year, Ben! Best wishes to you and your family.
Ben: Thank you. What are your wishes this year?
Anna: I wish to learn more English and make new friends.
Ben: Me too! Let's share a smile and start the new year together.
lessons.cn:
本：新年快乐，安娜！
安娜：新年快乐，本！祝你和家人一切顺利。
本：谢谢。你今年的愿望是什么？
安娜：我希望学更多英语、交新朋友。
本：我也是！让我们带着笑容一起开启新年。

lessons.title: A new year, new me
lessons.en: A new year has come! I have many new wishes. I wish to study hard and read more storybooks. I wish to help Mum at home and share with my friends. Most of all, I wish my family and all my friends a year full of smiles. Happy New Year, everyone!
lessons.cn: 新的一年到了！我有很多新愿望。我希望努力学习、多读故事书。希望在家帮妈妈、和朋友们分享。最重要的，我祝家人和所有朋友新的一年充满微笑。大家新年快乐！
